answer_1.quote: In this work, we investigate the extent to which generative language models following the GPT-2 (124M-1.5B parameters) and architecture respond to such framing effects. We compare the generations that models produce when given linguistically-biased prompts to those produced when given minimally-different neutral prompts.

answer_2.quote: We use perplexity to quantify whether there are differences in the overall distribution of language generated from each of the two sets of prompts.
